// Classifier fixture, node:test: subtests, suites and kinds. Read as text by the classifier suites under tests/.
import { it, suite, test } from "node:test";
import { strict as assert } from "node:assert";

test("publishing", async (t) => {
  await t.test("schedules", () => {
    assert.equal(schedule(), "SCHEDULED");
  });

  await t.test("publishes", () => {
    assert.equal(publish(), "PUBLISHED");
  });
});

suite("suite level", () => {
  it("works", () => {
    assert.equal(one(), 1);
  });
});
